panels.title: People active today

targets.rawSql:
with ev as (
  select created_at ts, payload->>'action' k, (payload->>'actor_id') uid from auth.audit_log_entries where payload->>'action' in ('login','user_signedup','user_recovery_requested')
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'rack (public)' else 'rack (private)' end, authorid::text from public.racks where authorid is not null
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'patch (public)' else 'patch (private)' end, authorid::text from public.patches where authorid is not null
  union all select rm.created::timestamptz, 'module placed in a rack', r.authorid::text from public.rack_modules rm join public.racks r on r.id = rm.rackid
  union all select created::timestamptz, 'collection', authorid::text from public.module_collections where authorid is not null
  union all select created, 'comment', "authorId"::text from public.comments where "authorId" is not null
  union all select created_at, 'reaction', user_id::text from public.reactions
  union all select created_at, 'module acquisition', profileid::text from public.user_module_acquisitions
  union all select created_at, 'marketplace listing', null from public.marketplace_listings) select count(distinct uid) as people from ev where ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) and uid is not null and k <> 'user_recovery_requested'

panels.title: Today vs yesterday vs a normal day

targets.rawSql:
with ev as (
  select created_at ts, payload->>'action' k, (payload->>'actor_id') uid from auth.audit_log_entries where payload->>'action' in ('login','user_signedup','user_recovery_requested')
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'rack (public)' else 'rack (private)' end, authorid::text from public.racks where authorid is not null
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'patch (public)' else 'patch (private)' end, authorid::text from public.patches where authorid is not null
  union all select rm.created::timestamptz, 'module placed in a rack', r.authorid::text from public.rack_modules rm join public.racks r on r.id = rm.rackid
  union all select created::timestamptz, 'collection', authorid::text from public.module_collections where authorid is not null
  union all select created, 'comment', "authorId"::text from public.comments where "authorId" is not null
  union all select created_at, 'reaction', user_id::text from public.reactions
  union all select created_at, 'module acquisition', profileid::text from public.user_module_acquisitions
  union all select created_at, 'marketplace listing', null from public.marketplace_listings),
d as (select case when k = 'login' then 'logins' when k = 'user_signedup' then 'signups' when k like 'rack%' then 'racks' when k like 'patch%' then 'patches'
  when k = 'module placed in a rack' then 'modules placed' when k in ('comment','reaction') then 'comments & reactions' else 'other' end as kind, k, uid, ts, (ts >= date_trunc('day', now())) today, (ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' and ts < date_trunc('day', now())) yest,
      (ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' and ts < date_trunc('day', now())) wk from ev where k <> 'user_recovery_requested')
select metric, today, yesterday, round(week_avg::numeric, 1) as avg_per_day_last_7 from (
 select 'People active' metric, 1 o, count(distinct uid) filter (where today) today, count(distinct uid) filter (where yest) yesterday,
   (select avg(c) from (select count(distinct uid) c from d where wk group by date_trunc('day', ts)) q) week_avg from d where uid is not null
 union all select 'Logins', 2, count(*) filter (where today and k='login'), count(*) filter (where yest and k='login'), count(*) filter (where wk and k='login')/7.0 from d
 union all select 'Signups', 3, count(*) filter (where today and k='user_signedup'), count(*) filter (where yest and k='user_signedup'), count(*) filter (where wk and k='user_signedup')/7.0 from d
 union all select 'Racks built', 4, count(*) filter (where today and k like 'rack%'), count(*) filter (where yest and k like 'rack%'), count(*) filter (where wk and k like 'rack%')/7.0 from d
 union all select 'Patches made', 5, count(*) filter (where today and k like 'patch%'), count(*) filter (where yest and k like 'patch%'), count(*) filter (where wk and k like 'patch%')/7.0 from d
 union all select 'Modules placed in racks', 6, count(*) filter (where today and k='module placed in a rack'), count(*) filter (where yest and k='module placed in a rack'), count(*) filter (where wk and k='module placed in a rack')/7.0 from d
 union all select 'Comments + reactions', 7, count(*) filter (where today and k in ('comment','reaction')), count(*) filter (where yest and k in ('comment','reaction')), count(*) filter (where wk and k in ('comment','reaction'))/7.0 from d) t order by o

panels.description: avg_per_day_last_7 = average of the 7 full days before today. Today is still in progress (UTC day).

panels.title: Activity per hour, last 48 hours

targets.rawSql:
with ev as (
  select created_at ts, payload->>'action' k, (payload->>'actor_id') uid from auth.audit_log_entries where payload->>'action' in ('login','user_signedup','user_recovery_requested')
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'rack (public)' else 'rack (private)' end, authorid::text from public.racks where authorid is not null
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'patch (public)' else 'patch (private)' end, authorid::text from public.patches where authorid is not null
  union all select rm.created::timestamptz, 'module placed in a rack', r.authorid::text from public.rack_modules rm join public.racks r on r.id = rm.rackid
  union all select created::timestamptz, 'collection', authorid::text from public.module_collections where authorid is not null
  union all select created, 'comment', "authorId"::text from public.comments where "authorId" is not null
  union all select created_at, 'reaction', user_id::text from public.reactions
  union all select created_at, 'module acquisition', profileid::text from public.user_module_acquisitions
  union all select created_at, 'marketplace listing', null from public.marketplace_listings)
select $__timeGroup(ts, '1h') as time, case when k = 'login' then 'logins' when k = 'user_signedup' then 'signups' when k like 'rack%' then 'racks' when k like 'patch%' then 'patches'
  when k = 'module placed in a rack' then 'modules placed' when k in ('comment','reaction') then 'comments & reactions' else 'other' end as metric, count(*) as events from ev where ts > now() - interval '48 hours' and k <> 'user_recovery_requested' group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Latest things people did

targets.rawSql:
with ev as (
  select created_at ts, payload->>'action' k, (payload->>'actor_id') uid from auth.audit_log_entries where payload->>'action' in ('login','user_signedup','user_recovery_requested')
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'rack (public)' else 'rack (private)' end, authorid::text from public.racks where authorid is not null
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'patch (public)' else 'patch (private)' end, authorid::text from public.patches where authorid is not null
  union all select rm.created::timestamptz, 'module placed in a rack', r.authorid::text from public.rack_modules rm join public.racks r on r.id = rm.rackid
  union all select created::timestamptz, 'collection', authorid::text from public.module_collections where authorid is not null
  union all select created, 'comment', "authorId"::text from public.comments where "authorId" is not null
  union all select created_at, 'reaction', user_id::text from public.reactions
  union all select created_at, 'module acquisition', profileid::text from public.user_module_acquisitions
  union all select created_at, 'marketplace listing', null from public.marketplace_listings)
select ts as time, case k when 'login' then 'Logged in' when 'user_signedup' then 'Signed up' when 'user_recovery_requested' then 'Asked for password reset'
  when 'rack (public)' then 'Built a rack (public)' when 'rack (private)' then 'Built a rack (private)'
  when 'patch (public)' then 'Made a patch (public)' when 'patch (private)' then 'Made a patch (private)'
  when 'module placed in a rack' then 'Placed a module in a rack' when 'collection' then 'Created a collection'
  when 'comment' then 'Wrote a comment' when 'reaction' then 'Gave a reaction' when 'module acquisition' then 'Logged a module purchase'
  when 'marketplace listing' then 'Listed a module for sale' else k end as what, case when uid is null then '' else 'user ' || left(uid, 6) end as who from ev
where ts > now() - interval '7 days' and k <> 'user_recovery_requested' order by ts desc limit 40

panels.description: Newest 40 events of the last 7 days. 'who' is the first 6 characters of the account id: same code = same person. No names or emails.

panels.title: People active per day (new vs returning)

targets.rawSql:
with ev as (
  select created_at ts, payload->>'action' k, (payload->>'actor_id') uid from auth.audit_log_entries where payload->>'action' in ('login','user_signedup','user_recovery_requested')
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'rack (public)' else 'rack (private)' end, authorid::text from public.racks where authorid is not null
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'patch (public)' else 'patch (private)' end, authorid::text from public.patches where authorid is not null
  union all select rm.created::timestamptz, 'module placed in a rack', r.authorid::text from public.rack_modules rm join public.racks r on r.id = rm.rackid
  union all select created::timestamptz, 'collection', authorid::text from public.module_collections where authorid is not null
  union all select created, 'comment', "authorId"::text from public.comments where "authorId" is not null
  union all select created_at, 'reaction', user_id::text from public.reactions
  union all select created_at, 'module acquisition', profileid::text from public.user_module_acquisitions
  union all select created_at, 'marketplace listing', null from public.marketplace_listings)
select $__timeGroup(e.ts, '1d') as time, case when u.created_at >= date_trunc('day', e.ts) then 'new that day' else 'returning' end as metric, count(distinct e.uid) as people
from ev e join auth.users u on u.id::text = e.uid where $__timeFilter(e.ts) and e.k <> 'user_recovery_requested' group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: When people are around (hour of day, last 7 days, Rome time)

targets.rawSql:
with ev as (
  select created_at ts, payload->>'action' k, (payload->>'actor_id') uid from auth.audit_log_entries where payload->>'action' in ('login','user_signedup','user_recovery_requested')
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'rack (public)' else 'rack (private)' end, authorid::text from public.racks where authorid is not null
  union all select created::timestamptz, case when public then 'patch (public)' else 'patch (private)' end, authorid::text from public.patches where authorid is not null
  union all select rm.created::timestamptz, 'module placed in a rack', r.authorid::text from public.rack_modules rm join public.racks r on r.id = rm.rackid
  union all select created::timestamptz, 'collection', authorid::text from public.module_collections where authorid is not null
  union all select created, 'comment', "authorId"::text from public.comments where "authorId" is not null
  union all select created_at, 'reaction', user_id::text from public.reactions
  union all select created_at, 'module acquisition', profileid::text from public.user_module_acquisitions
  union all select created_at, 'marketplace listing', null from public.marketplace_listings)
select lpad(extract(hour from ts at time zone 'Europe/Rome')::int::text, 2, '0') || ':00' as hour, count(*) as events
from ev where ts > now() - interval '7 days' and k <> 'user_recovery_requested' group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Modules people placed in racks this week

targets.rawSql:
select m.name as module, count(*) as times
from public.rack_modules rm join public.modules m on m.id = rm.moduleid where rm.created > now() - interval '7 days' group by m.id, m.name order by 2 desc limit 15

panels.title: Modules added to 'own' lists this week

targets.rawSql:
select m.name as module, count(*) as people
from public.user_modules um join public.modules m on m.id = um.moduleid where um.kind = 'HAS' and um.updated > now() - interval '7 days' group by m.id, m.name order by 2 desc limit 15

panels.description: Based on the last change time of a list entry; bulk edits can inflate it.

panels.title: New people this week: what did they do?

targets.rawSql:
select u.created_at as signed_up, 'user ' || left(u.id::text, 6) as who,
  (select count(*) from public.racks r where r.authorid = u.id) as racks,
  (select count(*) from public.patches p where p.authorid = u.id) as patches,
  (select count(*) from public.user_modules um where um.profileid = u.id) as module_list_entries,
  (select count(*) from auth.sessions s where s.user_id = u.id) as sessions
from auth.users u where u.created_at > now() - interval '7 days' and u.deleted_at is null order by u.created_at desc limit 20
